name: The Ritz Carlton, Cleveland
positioning: Downtown Cleveland hotel (officially The Ritz-Carlton, Cleveland) with a grey-and-blue design and an indoor walkway to Rocket Arena
best_for: Travelers attending events at Rocket Arena
Guests who want a Club Lounge with food and drink through the day

facts.text: The design uses a palette of grey and blue with touches of metal.
Rooms offer panoramic views of the Cuyahoga River and Lake Erie.
The Ritz-Carlton Club lounge is on the fourteenth floor of the hotel.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
Rooms have Nespresso coffeemakers and smart TVs capable of streaming Netflix.
The fitness center includes Peloton bikes.
The Ritz Kids program offers daily kid-friendly activities that introduce participants to the city's history and culture.
Dogs are welcome, up to 50 pounds.
Overnight valet parking is USD 60 per day.

highlights.text: TURN Bar + Kitchen, the hotel's restaurant, is a nod to the spirit and legacy of the city's steel-working industry.
A steam whistle sounds daily at 6 p.m. to mark the end of the workday and invite guests to enjoy drinks.
Rocket Arena is connected to the hotel via an indoor walkway.
Sushi by Bou is an intimate, speakeasy-inspired omakase restaurant at the hotel.
Signature experiences include making traditional pierogi with the chefs and a glassblowing session guided by a master artist.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary Club access.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style recreational facilities.
